title: Digital Glitch
blurb: Corrupted data does not actually sound like anything, but this is what we have collectively agreed it sounds like: a burst of stuttering digital noise, all bit-crush and torn static. The convention comes out of early-nineties science fiction and got permanently welded to internet visual language by vaporwave and datamosh edits. Now a single second of it is enough to tell a viewer that reality has just broken. Use it under a hard cut, over a zoom, or on any transition where you want the footage itself to feel like it is failing.
origin: A digital glitch and data-corruption sound effect.
